EXTERIOR AS BUILT · at sea, ramp raised
Profiles, plan, bow and stern from the game model
Drawn from the game itself, not redrawn by hand: buildFerryModel() (src/world/ferry-model.js) is built in Node exactly as the game builds
it; every visible triangle is projected orthographically and hidden lines are removed against a 10 mm depth buffer. What this sheet shows
is what is modelled, including its faults.
Heights ABL are above the base line (keel); the model frame is the laden waterline. Frames (Fr) at 500 mm from the transom. Glass is
drawn opaque, as an elevation does. The people, mooring lines and the shore are not part of the ship and are not drawn here: see sheet
The DXF beside this sheet is the same drawing in millimetres at sheet size (layers OUTLINE, DETAIL, MARKING, WATERLINE, CENTRE, DIM,
AS-BUILT SURVEY OF THE GAME MODEL · Johansson World vessel · no flag, class or construction approval · drawn by projecting buildFerryModel() with hidden lines removed
